# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Jerseytheworld
An online sports apparel store specializing in football and basketball jerseys. The business focuses on selling official or replica sports shirts for fans and players, catering to the sports enthusiast market. The store likely carries a wide range of team jerseys from local and international leagues.
